title: The readout, on the desk
summary: The readout on the desk (paper): four cards, one per part, each with its title, first line and exhibit WORD FOR WORD as /reports sets them (coherence pass; Exhibit 2 in its two columns, Exhibit 4 as numbered steps), folios 3, 5, 7, 8 as on /reports; beside them who the specimen was written for and the way to all nine pages; at the foot the confirmed sequence, Call 01 named “the strategic call” as the gate books it.

reference.site: Approved round-8 audit-readout (P09: four folio sheets dealt from a stack) · kit 12.5 (.ac-sheet) · GoNimbly study (few, big labels; real-looking objects)
reference.borrowed: A document shown as its own pages lying on a desk, each carrying its real exhibit.
reference.kelwin: The readout is built once (reports-readout/S) and reused: the same running head ('Kelwin · System Audit readout' | 'Specimen'), part titles, first lines and exhibit words, a folio; two columns of pages, the second set 96px lower, on the --panel desk /reports uses. No drawn metaphors, no greeking, no chips, no window chrome. The sequence is a timetable in type: no arrows, no rules.

motion: entrance: the side column (label, the 42px claim, the specimen line and link) fades and rises. The pages fade in as one stack on Part 1's place, then Parts 2–4 are dealt to their places, 100ms apart (640ms each; opaque paper, transform only). The timetable's heading fades, then its four rows rise in order.
ambient: none. interaction: 'Read all nine pages' (→ /reports).
on the live site: plays once when the section is 40% visible. Reduced motion: the laid-out desk at once.
story: Answers 'what exactly do I keep?' with the document itself — the four parts as the specimen's own pages, the same ones /reports prints in full — then 'what happens after?' with the confirmed sequence from the first call to a contract.

notes: KIT GAP (.ac-sheet--sm): a page at card scale — 28px margins, a 24px title, a 16px lead, 13.5px table type — set on this section's own four pages.
